summary: - **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1712](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1712)** — Makes `DetElement::nominal()`, `DetElement::survey()` and `VolumeManager::getVolumeManager()` thread-safe. These objects were created lazily without protection, which crashed multi-threaded `ddsim` runs with ALLEGRO when segmentation classes queried the VolumeManager concurrently from Geant4 worker threads. The added locking costs little: the cached values resolve within the first few events.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1713](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1713)** — Follow-up to #1712 that makes the computation of `DetElement::path()` and `DetElement::placementPath()` thread-safe, closing further race conditions in multi-threaded simulation.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1702](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1702)** — `Geant4ParticleHandler` no longer makes two full-size copies of the per-track equivalence map at end of event; it updates the map in place and moves it instead. A reviewer measured about 23% (1.5 GB) lower peak RSS on large events.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1709](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1709)** — Exceptions from a failed `getRefChild` lookup no longer list every defined constant in `e.what()` unless the `DD4HEP_LIST_CHILDREN` environment variable is set. The full listing produced thousands of lines of error output in large detector descriptions.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#120](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/120)** — `GenfitTrackFitter` no longer writes placeholder tracks (chi2 = ndf = -1, no hits or states) when every fit hypothesis fails. Failed fits are now dropped from `FittedTracks` and `FittedTracksWithFilteredHits`, so the output is no longer index-aligned with the input tracks. Downstream consumers relying on that alignment must adapt.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#543](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/543)** — Adds `GeneratorRandomSeed` and `SimulationRandomSeed` metadata label constants for storing generator and simulation seeds, used by k4SimDelphes#167. Reviewers noted that DD4hep already stores its seed as `random.seed` at run level, so the conventions still need to be aligned.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#129](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/129)** — Adds `MaterialRecordingAlg`, which records material for ACTS material mapping by tracing geantino rays with the TGeo navigator through the DD4hep geometry. It runs as a plain `k4run` job, with no GDML export, Geant4 or ACTS Python bindings. Rays and mapping input are clipped at the ECAL inner face (overridable via `MaxR`/`MaxZ`), so material behind the calorimeter no longer lands on the outermost surfaces.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#108](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/108)** — Adds two-way CKF tracking: track states are found in both directions from the seed and stitched together, recovering measurements on layers inside the seeding layers. The change also fixes the `PropagateBackward` outside-in mode, which started from the wrong space point. A covariance inflation factor is configurable, and a MAIA-based CTest is included.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#295](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/295)** — Reduces CPU and memory use of the calorimeter cell-noise tools. Duplicated code from `ReadNoiseFromFileTool` and `NoiseCaloCellsFromFile*Tool` moves into a common `ReadNoiseFromFileBaseTool`, and the cell-ID-to-bin mapping is precomputed and cached. Results were verified identical for ALLEGRO.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#82](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/82)** — Adds a `reconstruction` stage run by a new `k4run` executor, so optimization objectives can be measured on reconstructed objects such as PFOs and tracks, not only on simulated hits. The stage runs a Gaudi job (e.g. CLDReconstruction) on each candidate's geometry and simulated events.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#88](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/88)** — `k4opt optimize` now runs nested studies: for each trial of a level (e.g. an ECAL cell size), it runs a study of the level below (e.g. Pandora thresholds), all sharing one worker pool and reuse index. This completes the series #84–#87, and the follow-ups #89–#92 add map-property parameters, a CLD π⁰ example and dashboard support.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/124)** — Studies now identify their software by the actual build rather than the `KEY4HEP_STACK` path. Previously a nightly slot overwritten by a later build could silently resume or reuse stages across different builds. Variables that were not signed before (`MARLIN_DLL`, `GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH`, `LD_PRELOAD`, `G4*DATA`) are now included; follow-ups #126 and #127 add content hashing of local builds and observation of what each stage actually used.
